verdict.rationale: Runloop documents a public API: SDKs in common languages target the Runloop API, there is a documented Agents API, and docs cover programmatic devbox operations such as command execution, files, logs, snapshots and tunnels. The API is also exposed to LLMs via llms.txt and AI-tool context pages. The OpenAPI probe 404 shows only that no spec sits at the candidate paths, not that the API is missing, so it is not a dispute. Missing for 10: a directly cited REST API reference or machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the platform end-to-end via the API.
